newsitem.title: USA: Lighthouse Landings to acquire Milamax.
newsitem.headline: Lighthouse Landings to acquire Milamax.

text.p: Lighthouse Landings Inc said on Wednesday that it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Milamax Inc, a privately held company engaged in offshore casino operations.
Shares in Lighthouse Landings rose to 5 in afternoon trade, up by 1-1/2.
Lighthouse did not disclose a purchase price or reveal terms of the agreement.
With the acquisition, Lighthouse Landings said it would receive two casino boats and other assets totaling $30 million.

"The intent of the merged companies is to run offshore gaming operations and high speed ferry services at multiple locations in the metropolitan area as well as different sites up and down the east coast," Lighthouse Landings said in a statement.
It added that once the merger is complete it will apply for listing on a major stock exchange.
